prediction.likelyOutcome: 7205 Telegraph is likely to prevail on liability for breach of the condominium instruments and on declaratory relief invalidating the 2015 reallocation, given the admitted zoning shortfall and undisclosed board conflict of interest, but the damages award will likely land far below its expert's top-end $1.34M diminution figure once the court reconciles the competing appraisals against the actual 12-space post-reallocation reality. That recovery will be at least partially offset by exposure on the Association's unpaid-dues/lien claim stemming from 7205 Telegraph's self-help nonpayment strategy, an amount the record does not quantify.

Association's Claim for Unpaid Dues / Lien Enforcement

outcome.description: After a bench trial the Fairfax County Circuit Court entered judgment for 7205 Telegraph on all four counts, awarding $481,434.84 in lost-rent contract damages, a further $6,296.70 for over-assessments, release of the association's liens, and $324,977.60 in attorney's fees and costs. A Court of Appeals panel affirmed on April 25, 2023; rehearing en banc was granted, and on December 19, 2023 the court lifted the stay and left the judgment affirmed.
outcome.finalNote: Affirmed, including after rehearing en banc.
